name: Chimera Investments LLC
note: Abu Dhabi private investment firm, part of Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed's Royal Group empire (claim chimera-tahnoon-empire; Reuters 2023-09-15 phrases it 'part of Sheikh Tahnoun's private investment firm Royal Group'). Majority owner of Colnago since May 2020 (claim colnago-chimera-majority).
